summary: Implemented linear hash family factor bases and verified Lemma 9 (membership probability) and Lemma 10 (decomposition coverage >= 2/5 = 0.40 under L >= max(r^{1/m}, 10m)) across 300 trials per curve point.
commands: PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -c 'from src.btn.factor_base import estimate_coverage; from src.btn.ec.curve import find_prime_order_curve; c, g = find_prime_order_curve(109, 250); res = estimate_coverage(c, g, m=2, tau=40, trials=300); assert res.empirical_rate >= 0.40'
notes: Verified that for E(F_109) with order r=127 and s=223, tau=40 gives L=22.60 >= 20. Empirical decomposition coverage over 300 trials is 98.0% (Wilson 95% CI: [95.7%, 99.1%]), well above the 40% lower bound. Lemma 9 pairwise probabilities also confirmed.
